_comment: Quotation job for REFCON (Refrigerated Containers Industrial Co.), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Enquiry via business card of Eng. Tariq Dweik, Senior Sales Engineer, 2026-09-21.
Buyer identification: the card is the only source used. refcon.sa was checked and is
currently COMPROMISED (webshell banner, gambling spam), so nothing from it was trusted;
the only cross-check it provided is the switchboard number, which matches the card.
The hacked site prints P.O. Box 608 while the card prints 609 - the card wins.
Products matched from the client's own photos to catalogue records:
black body, red bar, top+bottom rods      -> 330   USD 18.90
silver bar on a white sandwich-panel door -> 302   USD 10.44
black outside lever with euro cylinder    -> 039   price on request
The trim is 039, NOT 016. Both are black keyed outside levers, and the first pass of
this quotation named 016 from the hero shots alone. The dimension drawings settle it:
016 is a compact 110x60 mm plate with the lever and cylinder side by side, while the
client's photo shows a slim tall plate with the lever above and the cylinder below -
039, whose drawing gives 136x40 mm with a 108 mm lever projection.
The '3 points' wording is the client's, taken from their message and visible in the
photos; the catalogue records do not state a point count, so it is not invented here.
Price pairing comes from the client's own message text: the 18.90 line reads
'3 points push bar with red & black color', which is the 330. 10.44 is therefore the
302. The client confirmed on 2026-09-21 that the trim is the item with no price.
039 has no black photograph in the catalogue, so the row carries the silver one and the spec says so outright rather than captioning a silver picture as black.
